Game Overview

Hit And Run Solo Leveling is a runner title where embark on a thrilling journey as a stickman warrior, mastering parkour and combat to cleanse a monster-infested town. With fast-paced action, dynamic levels, and strategic battles against formidable bosses, you'll collect gems and upgrade skills to reach legendary hero status. Run, jump, and fight your way to victory!
